reason: The acceptance source is well-formed and genuinely distinguishes base-red semantic defects from infrastructure/precondition failures. I inspected the full 1884-line decoded gate source in bounded chunks (RUNNER_SOURCE bootstrap, TEST_SOURCE population, the embedded browser scripts, the classification pass, and the outer gate()). The oracle `priority()` correctly encodes the stated read contract: known priorities rank 3/2/1, unknown/absent/out-of-range sort last and stay visible, the `type(s) is int` guard rejects booleans/strings, and the tie key is (item_type, title, item_id, detail, source_domain) in code-point order with nulls after present strings. The 53-case population resolves to 24 test functions carrying `semantic_priority` assertions plus 29 pure controls; at base exactly 23 of those semantic cases fail with `SemanticPriorityFailure` (typed red) while `test_review_recognized_warning_and_unknown_neutral` passes because review already labels severity 3 as status-failed and everything else neutral, so its semantic assertion is a regression guard rather than a base-red trigger. That is consistent with the reported 23-typed-semantic / 30-pass split. I verified against the actual repository at base `82dbd9477029d6fda7df67edc617f45a1a4ceb59` that every consumer's real base defect is exercised: Operating Picture/Home/First Answer/Ingest Summary sort ascending (`a.severity ?? 9` / `ORDER BY severity`) and label severity 1 as warn; Review sorts `b.severity - a.severity` descending which promotes an out-of-range 7 above 3; console `severityRank` maps `>=3` to S1 (unknown becomes urgent) and sorts descending by raw numeric; wallboard warns on `Number(severity) >= 2` (unknown triggers warn); briefing sorts by `-int(severity)` (unknown first); assistant headline/evidence use raw `max` (unknown highest). All nine named consumers (Operating Picture, Home, First Answer, Ingest Summary, Review, console, wallboard, briefing composer, assistant) are covered without narrowing to four screens. No genuine scope or gate gap remains; Docker is an explicit prerequisite for real PostgreSQL, not a hosted-CI claim.
trivial_pass: Attacks attempted and why they fail: (1) Constant result / hardcoded answer — fails because assertions compare live API/browser/briefing/assistant output against an independently-computed oracle over real seeded rows; a candidate cannot pass by returning a constant without reproducing the real multiset and canonical order across all modes. (2) Oracle tautology — the oracle is in the test, but it is a faithful transcription of the spec read contract and is compared against the real `create_app`/`ReportingService` (warehouse, published, prefer-present, prefer-fallback), real PostgreSQL via Docker, a real `next build` standalone server, and a real Playwright Chromium browser (native, with an unavailable-native Docker fallback); the guard-falsification tests (`test_priority_oracle_rejects_inversion`, `test_source_value_guard_rejects_tampering`, `test_infrastructure_guards_reject_unavailable_hash_and_noop`) prove the guards actually catch inversions/tampering rather than vacuously passing. (3) Mock subject replacement — `consumer_publication` swaps only the published DATA via `replace_rows` and restores both `mart_open_attention_items` and `reporting_publication_snapshot`, asserting the multiset and snapshot bytes are unchanged; the subject under test remains the real production reader, projector, and components. (4) Missing outcome assertions — every consumer convention (ordering, tie order, label/rank, unknown neutrality, warning threshold, headline==evidence priority) has a distinct `semantic_priority` category, and no semantic assertion is unreachable. (5) Incorrect base-red classification — a plain `AssertionError` or setup/cleanup fault is classified 'infrastructure' (spec-gap) and rejects the run, never recorded as semantic red; only `SemanticPriorityFailure: HLA_SEMANTIC_PRIORITY:<category>` with a category declared for that base name is typed semantic. A candidate that merely installs helpers but leaves consumers inverted still fails the typed semantic assertions.
checks: Decoded and read all three embedded source bodies (RUNNER_SOURCE, TEST_SOURCE, BROWSER/CONSUMER_BROWSER scripts) plus the outer gate() in full; no truncated-preview reliance.

Confirmed 53 EXPECTED_CASES; 24 functions emit semantic_priority, 23 fail at base (typed semantic) and test_review_recognized_warning_and_unknown_neutral passes at base as a regression guard — matching the 23/30 red/pass split.

Verified the priority() oracle matches the read contract exactly (3/2/1 known rank, unknown/absent/out-of-range last and visible, type(s) is int rejecting bool/str, code-point tie order with null/missing after present strings).
Verified no consumer narrowing: Operating Picture, Home, First Answer, Ingest Summary, Review, console, wallboard, briefing, and assistant are each exercised against the real code path.

Verified real subject wiring: create_app, ReportingService (warehouse/published/prefer-present/prefer-fallback), real Postgres via Docker, real Next standalone build, real Playwright Chromium (native + Docker fallback), real compose_morning_brief, real /api/assistant/answer.

Verified base-red classification: semantic vs infrastructure separated via the failure-message regex; controls and guard-falsification tests pass at base; missing Docker/Node/build/browser/cleanup failures classify as infrastructure (spec-gap), not semantic evidence.

Verified source-value/multiset and duplicate preservation (test_duplicate_rows_preserved_real_http, assert_source_values), snapshot immutability (hash before/after reads), no_history-is-empty-not-current, OIDC permissions and 401/403 denial.

Verified lifecycle cleanup is actually tested (subreaper process groups, browser owner failure, exited-leader-ignoring-child, container removal), and portability prerequisites are explicit (Linux x86_64, Node 20 SHA256-pinned download, Docker for PG).
Confirmed acceptance source is external frozen bytes (SHA256-pinned) fully separate from candidate diff lines; no product implementation or worker test can be hidden inside it.

Confirmed the consumer conventions the spec must preserve are the exact ones asserted: briefing warning/notice/info, console S1/S2/S3 (3->S1) with unknowns unranked, wallboard valid-2-or-3 warning threshold with unknown non-warning, assistant headline and evidence naming the same highest valid priority.
